journey.name: Assistant draft opens Review
journey.description: A complete Proxmox draft from another app opens SparkWriter on its Review step, marks the values it filled, and does not start writing.

actions.action: If an "Allow write notifications?" dialog is shown, tap "Not now"
Verify that SparkWriter shows "Proxmox VE" and a "Review" heading under Configuration
Verify that "pve2.srv.home.arpa" is shown with "Prefilled from another app" below it
Scroll down in the Review list until "Management VLAN ID" is visible
Verify that "Management VLAN ID" shows 30 and "Prefilled from another app"
Verify that no write or save progress is shown
